walkthroughs.body_html:
Theme 1: Marketing and People — a core area of A-Level Business Studies.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Theme 1: Marketing and People brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Theme 1: Marketing and People.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

options: McKinsey
BCG
Bain
Deloitte

mcqs.q: Selling new products to existing customers (Ansoff) is:
options: Market penetration
Market development
Product development
Diversification

mcqs.q: What three Ps are added to make the extended marketing mix (7Ps)?
options: People (staff/service quality), Process (how the service is delivered), and Physical Evidence (tangible cues — uniforms, packaging, branding) — added to make the 4Ps relevant to services marketing.
Operations management is only about manufacturing factories.
The 7Ps include Profit, Planning and Performance.
The 7Ps are just the 4Ps repeated with different words.

mcqs.q: What is a brand in marketing?
options: Operations management is only about manufacturing factories.
A brand is the company that makes a product.
A brand is just the logo on a product.
A combination of name, design, symbols and associations that distinguishes a product and creates customer perception and loyalty — more than just a logo.

mcqs.q: What is operations management concerned with?
options: Operations management is the same as general management.
Operations management is only about manufacturing factories.
A brand is the company that makes a product.
The design and control of the production process and business operations — converting inputs into outputs efficiently. It includes capacity, quality, supply chain, and process improvement.
